requirements.businessContext: Module 16 covers the platform-wide superadmin surface: a single dashboard (/app/superadmin) and a set of /api/superadmin/* endpoints that only `session.type === "superadmin"` callers may invoke. It owns admin-user CRUD (create / edit / delete / password reset), league-admin assignments (mapping `admin`-role users onto specific leagues via the `league_admins` table), the singleton PL-Standings tier config used by the Club Auction (top8 / mid / promoted), and manual GW score-adjustment authentication + audit trail (the math itself lives in module 11). League CRUD lives in module 02, auth itself in module 01.

businessRules.rule: Every /api/superadmin/* endpoint MUST call isSuperAdmin(request) before doing any work; isSuperAdmin returns true only when the middleware-attached header x-session-type equals 'superadmin'. Non-superadmin callers receive 403 with body { error: "Superadmin access required" }.

GET /api/superadmin/admins returns every user whose role is 'admin' OR 'superadmin', sorted by createdAt ascending, with each row augmented by assignedLeagueIds[] derived from the league_admins table.

POST /api/superadmin/admins validates: name is a non-empty string <=100 chars; email matches /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ AND is <=254 chars; password is 8-256 chars AND contains at least one number or special character. Each failure returns HTTP 400 with an explicit message. Email is then lowercased before insert (BR-SUPER-006).

POST /api/superadmin/admins lowercases and trims the email before storing it; password is bcrypt-hashed at cost 12; id is generated via generateId(); role is hard-coded to 'admin' (a superadmin cannot be created via this route); mustChangePassword is forced to true on creation.

POST /api/superadmin/admins returns 409 with { error: "An admin with that email already exists" } if the insert fails (caught generically, relies on the unique index on users.email). The success response echoes id, name, email, role:'admin', mustChangePassword:true, assignedLeagueIds:[].

Both POST /api/superadmin/admins and PATCH /api/superadmin/admins/[userId] normalize an admin's email via .trim().toLowerCase() before persisting. This keeps the unique-email index, the case-insensitive signin lookup (via stored-lowercase compare), and the displayed email consistent.
PATCH /api/superadmin/admins/[userId]: when a password is supplied, mustChangePassword is forced back to true and the password is bcrypt-hashed at cost 12.

PATCH /api/superadmin/admins/[userId] stamps updatedAt = new Date() whenever any field is updated, and returns 409 with { error: "Email already in use by another admin" } when the unique-email constraint fires.
PATCH /api/superadmin/admins/[userId] looks up the target row before mutating; if no row exists with that userId, returns HTTP 404 'User not found'. Mirrors the existing DELETE handler's behaviour.

PATCH /api/superadmin/admins/[userId] rejects with 403 { error: "Cannot modify another superadmin's account" } when the target user's role is 'superadmin' AND target.id !== request.headers.get('x-session-id') — i.e. only self-service edits of a superadmin row are permitted (a superadmin may always edit their own name/email/password). Admin-role targets are unaffected and continue to fall through to the standard update path.

DELETE /api/superadmin/admins/[userId] first looks up the target user; if missing returns 404 with { error: "User not found" }; if role is 'superadmin' returns 403 with { error: "Cannot delete a superadmin account" }.
DELETE /api/superadmin/admins/[userId] runs inside a transaction that first deletes every league_admins row for the user, then deletes the user row itself — the two deletes succeed or fail together.

POST /api/superadmin/league-assignments requires both userId and leagueId in the body (400 if either missing). The target user must exist (404) and must have role === 'admin' — assignments are explicitly rejected for superadmin or non-existent roles with 400 { error: "League assignments only apply to admin users" }. The target league must exist (404).

POST /api/superadmin/league-assignments creates a row in league_admins with a fresh generateId(); a uniqueIndex(leagueId,userId) makes re-assignment idempotent at the API surface by returning 409 with { error: "This admin is already assigned to that league" }.

DELETE /api/superadmin/league-assignments looks up the leagueAdmins row first; returns HTTP 404 'Assignment not found' when no matching (userId, leagueId) row exists, otherwise deletes and returns HTTP 200 with {success:true}.

GET /api/superadmin/pl-standings is self-seeding: if no row with id PL_STANDINGS_SEED_ID ('current') exists, it inserts one using the hard-coded constants PL_STANDINGS_SEED_SEASON ('2025-26'), PL_STANDINGS_SEED_TOP8 (8 IDs), PL_STANDINGS_SEED_MID (9 IDs), PL_STANDINGS_SEED_PROMOTED (3 IDs).

GET /api/superadmin/pl-standings returns { id, season, top8:number[], mid:number[], promoted:number[], updatedAt:ISOString|null, plTeams:[{id,name,short_name}] } — plTeams is the live FPL bootstrap team list sorted by name; if the bootstrap fetch throws, plTeams is returned as [] and the rest of the response still succeeds.
PUT /api/superadmin/pl-standings requires a non-empty trimmed string season (400 if missing). It returns 400 with { error: "Invalid JSON body" } if the request body is not parseable JSON.

PUT /api/superadmin/pl-standings enforces tier sizes exactly: top8 length === 8, mid length === 9, promoted length === 3. Each must be an array of integers. Any deviation returns 400 with a tier-specific error message.

PUT /api/superadmin/pl-standings rejects duplicate IDs across the three lists (400 { error: "Team IDs must be unique across top8 / mid / promoted" }) and rejects a combined length not equal to 20 (400 { error: "Total of top8 + mid + promoted must be 20 team IDs" }).

PUT /api/superadmin/pl-standings validates every integer in top8 + mid + promoted against the live FPL bootstrap teams set (via fetchBootstrapData). Any integer not found in the bootstrap returns HTTP 400 with body { error, invalidIds: [...] }; the row is NOT written. Bootstrap fetch failures or empty teams return HTTP 503 (fail-closed) rather than persisting unverified IDs.

PUT /api/superadmin/pl-standings calls readOrSeedConfig() before the UPDATE so a brand-new database can be PUT to directly; it stores top8/mid/promoted as JSON.stringify-ed strings and stamps updatedAt = now. Response echoes { success:true, season, top8, mid, promoted, updatedAt }.

GET /api/superadmin/score-adjustments without a leagueId returns bootstrap data: every league where format === 'auction' (ordered by createdAt desc) plus a gwsByLeague map listing the distinct gameweek numbers that have auction_scores rows for that league, sorted ascending.

GET /api/superadmin/score-adjustments?leagueId=...&gameweek=N requires gameweek to parse as an integer (400 if not); resolves (leagueId, gameweek number) to a gameweekId; 404 with { error: "GW<n> not found in this league" } if no match.

GET /api/superadmin/score-adjustments?leagueId=...&gameweek=N returns scores[] containing { id, teamId, teamName, totalPoints, rawPoints, synergyBonus, clubResultBonus, rank, payout } sorted by rank ascending (joined to teams for the display name).

PATCH /api/superadmin/score-adjustments requires id (string) and reason (non-empty after trim) in the body — missing either returns 400. At least one of synergyBonus or clubResultBonus must be an integer; supplying neither returns 400 { error: "Provide at least one of synergyBonus or clubResultBonus" }.

PATCH /api/superadmin/score-adjustments looks up the auction_scores row by id (404 if missing) and computes newTotal = rawPoints + (newSynergy) + (newClubResult), where each `new*` falls back to the existing column value if not supplied in the body. rawPoints is never editable through this route.

PATCH /api/superadmin/score-adjustments writes the new synergyBonus, clubResultBonus, totalPoints in a transaction together with an auditLogs row of type 'AUCTION_SCORE_ADJUSTMENT' whose description encodes the before→after values and the supplied reason, and whose pointsAffected equals deltaTotal (new - old totalPoints). The audit log is linked to teamId and gameweekId from the score row.

PATCH /api/superadmin/score-adjustments adjusts the targeted auctionScores row (totalPoints, synergyBonus, clubResultBonus) and, in the SAME transaction, re-ranks every auctionScores row in (leagueId, gameweekId) by totalPoints desc with teamId asc as a deterministic tiebreaker. Each row whose computed rank or payout changes is updated with the new rank and the new payout (resolved via getPayoutForRank in src/lib/formats/auction/economy.ts). For every team whose payout changed, teams.purse and teams.totalIncome are adjusted by the payout delta (positive when the rank improved, negative when it dropped), keeping the leaderboard, admin finance overview, and the GW payout ledger fully consistent.

PATCH /api/superadmin/score-adjustments reads the acting superadmin's userId from the x-session-id header (set by middleware after isSuperAdmin passes) and prefixes the inserted auditLogs.description with '[Superadmin <userId>]'. If the header is somehow absent the prefix is '[Superadmin unknown]'. No schema change — actor info is embedded in the description until a dedicated actorUserId column is added platform-wide.

PATCH /api/superadmin/score-adjustments validates synergyBonus and clubResultBonus separately. synergyBonus is any finite number in [-500, 500] (REAL column). clubResultBonus is an integer in [-500, 500] (INTEGER column). Both have distinct error messages; out-of-range or wrong-shape values return HTTP 400.

The superadmin dashboard /app/superadmin has five tabs — Leagues, Admins, Operations, PL Standings, Score Adjustments — initially 'leagues'. PL Standings and Score Adjustments lazily fetch their data on first activation (and not before).
Superadmin dashboard data-fetchers redirect the browser to /signin whenever an API call returns 401 or 403 — applies to fetchAdmins, fetchStandings, fetchAdjBootstrap, fetchLeagues.

Admins tab UI: the role pill renders 'superadmin' in yellow and 'admin' in purple; superadmin rows display 'All leagues' in place of an assigned-league count; the Edit button is available for every row, but Leagues (assign) and Delete buttons are hidden for superadmin rows.
Assign-Leagues modal toggles each league via POST/DELETE /api/superadmin/league-assignments and updates client state immediately (changes persist on each click; no 'Save' button).

Create-League wizard's final step iterates wizardSelectedAdminIds and POSTs to /api/superadmin/league-assignments for each chosen admin in parallel; on success it refreshes the admin list so assignment counts stay current. Skipping the assignment step is supported via handleWizardFinish(true).

PL-Standings UI client-side guard: Save Standings shows an error toast and aborts the PUT if any tier count is wrong (top8 !== 8 OR mid !== 9 OR promoted !== 3); on success it updates the displayed updatedAt timestamp.

PL-Standings UI: moving a team into the 'promoted' tier auto-sorts that tier alphabetically by team name (positions 18/19/20 are always shown alphabetically); moving into top8/mid appends to the end of the list.

Score-Adjustments UI: Save is disabled until both an edit exists AND a non-empty reason has been typed; the displayed Total column previews row.rawPoints + effectiveSynergy + effectiveClubResult live as the user types.

Create-Admin form requires name, email, and password (HTML `required`); the modal copy explicitly warns 'Admin will be asked to change this on first login.' Edit-Admin form treats name, email, and password as all optional but warns when a new password is entered that the admin will be forced to change it on next login.

defects.description: POST /api/superadmin/admins lowercases+trims the email before insert (src/app/api/superadmin/admins/route.ts:67), but PATCH only trims (src/app/api/superadmin/admins/[userId]/route.ts:34-36).
